text: anya: Quick idea: evaluate micro-peering (tenant -> regional edge VPC) + tiny edge-proxy vs our hosted-relay. aiming to preserve egress IPs and reduce relay fleet spikes. marco: +1. two modes: reserved (paid pin) vs ephemeral (auto-create on sustained traffic). devon: Main limits: peerings per account, route table size, IAM accept flow. lia: Route table churn is a big ops risk. need tagging + garbage collection. anya: Controller idea: create peer when tenant.rps > HWM for N mins, teardown after idle TTL unless pinned. marco: Keep a warm pool of spare peerings to reduce attach latency. devon: Observability: peer_count, attach_rate, route_ops, peer_failures. infra-bot: quota_warn: peering_count=46 region=us-west-2 threshold=48 notify=@devon @lia. lia: Security: tag routes with tenant-id and restrict SGs on proxies. sam: (ops) acceptance flow: support automated accept or token-based acceptance for tenant accounts. anya: Fallback: always route to hosted-relay if peer create fails; metrics + alert. marco: Tests: 200-peering attach in staging, measure attach/teardown times and route convergence. devon: Cost model needed: per-tenant peering + proxy vm vs relay fleet under churn. action items: @marco spike, @devon quotas, @lia security checklist, infra-bot wire alerts. anya: Thanks — will keep this thread as the working doc. :rocket:
